curcumin_bcm95.key: 800 mg BioCurc turmeric root extract per 2 softgels, an enhanced-absorption form (curcumin amount not stated on the label)
curcumin_bcm95.src: Curcumin 400x sell sheet ND466 (Rev. 7/24; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials), Supplement Facts per 2 softgels: BioCurc (rhizome extract; Curcuma longa) 800 mg, no curcuminoid amount stated; directions two softgels daily. Product DB R268 agrees in every chart read ("curcuminoid percentage not stated"). Replaces the earlier "800 mg curcumin" line, which turned an extract weight into a curcumin amount. (Kept here as a shared label correction for the other sheets that use curcumin_bcm95; the lyme sheet itself no longer does.)

mito.key: Per 3 capsules: 300 mg taurine, 200 mg acetyl-L-carnitine, 100 mg CoQ10, 100 mg NAC, 75 mg alpha-lipoic + 45 mg R-lipoic acid, 7 mg PQQ, 75 mg magnesium
mito.src: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 (Rev. 2/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials), Supplement Facts per 3 capsules (30 servings): vitamin C 150 mg, vitamin E 25 mg, vitamin K1 250 mcg, thiamin 25 mg, riboflavin 12 mg, niacin 12 mg NE, B6 (P5P) 7.5 mg, magnesium 75 mg (malate, ascorbate), selenium 25 mcg, taurine 300 mg, acetyl-L-carnitine HCl 200 mg, resveratrol 100 mg, CoQ10 100 mg, NAC 100 mg, EGCG 100 mg, quercetin 100 mg, alpha-lipoic acid 75 mg, R-alpha-lipoic acid 45 mg, sulforaphane glucosinolate 15 mg, hydroxytyrosol 10 mg, PQQ 7 mg; directions three capsules daily. Matches the CellCore and HydrOxygen chart reads in the product DB (R167); the earlier line used only the Ortho chart read and left out taurine, CoQ10, PQQ and magnesium. (Kept here as a shared label correction for the other sheets that use the mito key; the lyme sheet uses ly_mito.)

ly_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
ly_ultrabiotic_dms.src: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain sell sheet ND460 (Rev. 7/24; Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 1 capsule, 30 billion CFU at time of manufacture: Saccharomyces boulardii Lynside, Lactobacillus reuteri LRC, Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, L. plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05, Bacillus coagulans UABc-20; directions one capsule daily; dairy-free. URL slug from products.SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc). Bedtime slot and the 2-hour antibiotic gap are this sheet's timing advice, not label text.

ly_immune_prp.name: Immune PRP Pro
ly_immune_prp.key: Per 4 capsules: 1,720 mg bovine colostrum, standardized to 30% IgG antibodies, with PRP, IgA, IgM and lactoferrin
ly_immune_prp.src: Immune PRP Pro sell sheet ND1054 (Rev. 8/24; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 4 capsules (30 servings): Bovine Colostrum Blend [immunoglobulin G (IgG), proline-rich polypeptides (PRP), other immunoglobulins (IgA, IgM), lactoferrin] (standardized to 30% IgG) 1,720 mg; Contains: Milk. Label directions, verbatim: 'Take four capsules twice daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The sheet prints that label dose (8 capsules a day, so one 120-capsule bottle lasts 15 days). Same facts and the same directions in labels.json (R2178) and in NutriDyn's own 60-day protocol doc 'NUTRIDYN FORMULAS Protocols - 60 Day Gut Repair and Detox' (2025-04-28): 'Take four capsules twice daily'. Protocol basis for the pick: the NutriDyn GLC 2019 protocol sheet "Botanical Medicines in Complex, Multi-Pathogen Disease" (Dropbox Seminar Notes and Protocols/GLC 2019), Immune Support, which uses a lower practitioner dose ('Immune PRP Pro (R2178) 2 capsules 2x/day'); a practitioner who wants that dose writes it under Special considerations. Size R2178 120C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). No nutridyn.com slug on file, so the link falls back to the catalog search. PHOTO: the sheet still prints the SOFT 4x stopgap (img-src/R2178.png, 352x640 from a 160 px thumbnail). Print sources found 2026-11-03: Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R2178_Web, 2026-05-13, the current NutriDyn web render) and an older 2019 render, /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/Marketing Club/_gsdata_/_saved_/2019/10. October - Immune Health/web/immune_prp_pro.png; check it shows the current label before use). Not downloadable from the build session (dl.dropboxusercontent.com is denied by its network policy); stage the chosen file centrally as build/img-src/R2178.png and drop R2178 from img-src/soft.json.

ly_inflam_eze.name: Inflam-Eze Plus
ly_inflam_eze.key: Per 3 capsules: 800 mg ginger root; extracts: 250 mg CurQfen (curcumin with fenugreek fiber), 250 mg boswellia, 200 mg white willow bark, 150 mg hops, 60 mg devil's claw
ly_inflam_eze.src: Inflam-Eze Plus sell sheet ND516 (Rev. 5/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 3 capsules: ginger powder (root) 800 mg; proprietary mix of curcumin extract (35% curcuminoids) and fenugreek galactomannans extract (CurQfen) 250 mg; Boswellia serrata gum extract (65% boswellic acid) 250 mg; white willow extract (bark; 25% salicin) 200 mg; hops extract (2% xanthohumol) 150 mg; devil's claw extract (1.2% harpagosides) 60 mg; directions 'Take 3 capsules once daily with food or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' The serving line keeps every amount and says which are extracts: 250 mg is the CurQfen complex (curcumin with fenugreek fiber), not 250 mg of curcumin, and 200 mg is a bark extract, not raw bark. Same panel in labels.json (R856/R856L) and the product DB (Ortho, Metagenics, Nutritional Frontiers chart reads). ND516's claims, re-read 2026-11-03 (Dropbox text extraction): 'Promote healthy inflammatory markers in the body', 'Support healthy immune function and oxidative stress', 'Support overall health and well-being'; it calls the 800 mg 'ginger root powder'. The sheet prints the first and the third, and no joint claim. Sizes R856 90C / R856L 180C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Protocol basis: a NutriDyn educator's product key maps 'Botanical Anti-inflam' to Inflam-eze Plus in the Gut-Neuro-Immune Restoration care plan (1-3 breakfast, 1-3 supper) from Asher's 2025 fatigue/immune seminar, which covered tick-borne disease. URL slug from products.SLUGS (inflam_eze).

ly_glutathione.name: Liposomal Glutathione
ly_glutathione.key: 100 mg reduced L-glutathione per 1 mL dropper, in liposomes made with sunflower lecithin
ly_glutathione.src: Liposomal Glutathione sell sheet ND971 (Rev. 8/24; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 1 dropper (1 mL), 60 servings: L-glutathione (reduced) 100 mg; other ingredients include non-GMO sunflower lecithin; directions 'Shake well. Take one full dropper (1 mL) 2-4 times daily'; tagline 'Bioavailable Antioxidant and Detox Support'. Same amount and directions in the product DB (R2188, five chart reads). Size R2188 60 mL (ND144 price list 10/1/26). Protocol basis: the NutriDyn GLC 2019 protocol sheet "Botanical Medicines in Complex, Multi-Pathogen Disease" (Dropbox Seminar Notes and Protocols/GLC 2019), 'Detoxification Support - for herxing: Liposomal Glutathione (R2188) 5 pumps up to 4x/day as needed for herxing'. No nutridyn.com slug on file, so the link falls back to the catalog search. Timing on the sheet: morning and evening meal (the label sets no time of day; glutathione has no minerals, so doxycycline spacing does not apply). Print source found 2026-11-03: Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R2188_web, 2026-05-13, the current NutriDyn web render; no larger Liposomal Glutathione image found in Dropbox). ly_mito.name: Mito Recharge
ly_mito.key: Per 3 capsules: 200 mg acetyl-L-carnitine, 100 mg NAC, 75 mg alpha-lipoic + 45 mg R-lipoic acid, 75 mg magnesium, 250 mcg vitamin K1
ly_mito.src: Mito Recharge sell sheet ND812 (Rev. 2/25; Dropbox NutriDyn Marketing Materials, re-opened 2026-11-03): Supplement Facts per 3 capsules (30 servings) as listed under the shared 'mito' entry above, including vitamin K1 (as phytonadione) 250 mcg and magnesium (as malate and ascorbate) 75 mg; directions three capsules daily. Size R167 90C (ND144 price list 10/1/26). The magnesium is why it sits away from doxycycline: the sheet puts it at bedtime, because twice-daily doxycycline is taken with breakfast and the evening meal and not right before lying down, so bedtime is 2 to 3 hours from both doses (the timing is this sheet's advice, not label text). The vitamin K1 is why the warfarin note names it. URL slug from products.SLUGS (mito). Protocol basis: a NutriDyn educator's 'Mold Care ~ Preparation Plan' for Asher's 2025 fatigue/immune seminar (seminar materials, Google Drive) lists Mito Recharge 1-3 at breakfast and 1-3 at supper; it is also the NutriDyn match for the competitor's mitochondrial category (NAC, acetyl-L-carnitine, lipoic acid).
